Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANIT Bhopal Internal Auditor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MANIT Bhopal Internal Auditor recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Internal Auditor post at MANIT Bhopal is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Internal Auditor post at MANIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Retired Senior Audit Officers from CAG and possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university or institute to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Internal Auditor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Internal Auditor post is 65 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Internal Auditor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Internal Auditor position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 80,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Internal Auditor post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Internal Auditor post at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Internal Auditor position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Internal Auditor role at MANIT Bhopal will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, 462003.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of MANIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: The official website of Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal is www.manit.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information.
